numeric.purpose: Stable fan percentages and preset values.

shadows.name: slider-thumb
shadows.purpose: Legibility for the white slider thumb on dark glass.

motion.name: glide
motion.purpose: Thumb, fill, frost reveal and halo for pointer jumps, preset clicks and model changes. Keyboard (arrows, 1-6, M) is instant.

motion.name: ice-formation
motion.value: 620ms freezing front from the thumb to the crystal onset, one glint riding it
motion.purpose: A user reaching 100% cooling crystallises the top of the lattice (Expressive only).

motion.name: melt
motion.value: 280ms ease-in-out fade from wherever the front is
motion.purpose: Crystals melt when cooling is lowered; an interrupted formation never snaps to full.

motion.name: release-sweep
motion.purpose: Light runs back along the lit dots after a pointer release.

motion.name: aura
motion.purpose: Heat band change; a rising band breathes in once.

motion.name: percent-roll
motion.purpose: Requested percentage turns over on a preset click; drags and keys never roll.

motion.name: chill
motion.purpose: Cold air at the lower edge follows measured fan speed as the fan spins up or down.

motion.name: trend-inspect
motion.purpose: Hairline, probe and exact value for the sample under the pointer.

motion.name: key-acknowledge
motion.purpose: A preset applied by its number key.

motion.name: editor-row
motion.purpose: A newly added preset row settles in; focus edge 150ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: System Reduce Motion removes all movement; static state remains.

narrative.overview: Aervane is a compact native macOS menu-bar instrument. Temperature leads; direct percentage control follows. Layout and controls carry state with minimal copy. Point of view: warm light behind the glass, frost on it — heat glows behind the reading, measured airflow chills the lower edge, the cooling command frosts the slider.
keyCharacteristics: Heat behind the glass, frost on it
Ice for cooling, heat for temperature

rules.name: The State Must Speak Rule
rules.body: Use plain-language state labels with semantic color; color never carries status alone.

rules.name: The Stable Number Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced digits for values that change during interaction.

rules.name: The Material First Rule
rules.body: Use native glass and tonal separation before adding shadow.

rules.name: The Two Families Rule
rules.body: Cooling is never warm and heat is never icy.

rules.name: The Measured Air Rule
rules.body: Atmosphere that describes the fan follows measured speed, never the request; requested speed lives on the slider.

dos: Keep temperature first and the direct percentage control immediately available.
Preserve the hardware minimum and distinguish requested from measured speed.
Let every core action work from the keyboard without capturing text-field keys.
Edit presets on a draft: Save stores, Cancel discards, closing the panel keeps edits.
donts: Do not add taglines, footers or section labels.
Do not describe preview as applied.
Do not add idle animation, timers or particles.
Do not let a heat state imply that manual control is blocked.
Do not use literal snowflakes or decorative glow; frost is grain and crystal on the lattice.
